title: B.Tech AI & Data Science Program Overview & Intake
content: The B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence & Data Science (AI & DS) is a 4-year, 8-semester undergraduate degree approved by AICTE and affiliated with State Technical University. Intake capacity is 120 seats per academic year. The program covers Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, MLOps, Big Data Analytics, Reinforcement Learning, and Generative AI. Students undertake 2 capstone projects, 1 summer research internship, and utilize the Advanced Supercomputing Lab equipped with NVIDIA A100 GPUs.

title: Undergraduate Admission Eligibility & Entrance Exams
content: Admission to B.Tech programs requires 10+2 (Higher Secondary) with Physics, Mathematics as mandatory subjects along with Chemistry/Computer Science/Biology. General Category candidates require a minimum aggregate of 60% (55% for SC/ST/OBC/PwD candidates). Admission routes: 1. State Engineering Entrance Examination (Counseling - 70% seats), 2. JEE Main Score Direct Merit Quota (20% seats, minimum 75 percentile required), 3. Management/Institutional NRI Merit Quota (10% seats based on Institute Written Assessment & Interview).

title: Tuition Fee Structure & Payment Deadlines (2026-27)
content: Annual Tuition Fee for B.Tech programs is ₹1,45,000 per annum (split into ₹72,500 per semester). Additional one-time fees at admission: Caution Money (Refundable): ₹10,000; Registration & Orientation Fee: ₹5,000; Library & Lab Security Deposit: ₹5,000. Semester payment deadlines: Odd Semester (Autumn): Due by August 10th; Even Semester (Spring): Due by January 15th. Late fee penalty of ₹100/day applies up to 14 days post deadline. Fee payments are handled via the ERP portal through UPI, Net Banking, or RTGS/NEFT.

title: Institutional Merit & Need-Based Scholarships
content: The Institute awards over ₹1.2 Crores annually in financial aid: 1. Apex Chancellor's Merit Scholarship: 100% tuition waiver for 10+2 scores > 95% or JEE Main percentile > 97. 2. Dean's Academic Excellence Scholarship: 50% tuition waiver for 10+2 aggregate between 90% and 94.9%. 3. Women in Tech Fellowship: 25% tuition fee waiver for all female students enrolling in AI & DS or CSE. 4. Need-Based Economic Concession: Up to 50% waiver for students with annual family income below ₹3.5 Lakhs (Income Certificate required). 5. Post-Matric SC/ST/OBC Scholarships as per State & National Scholarship Portal (NSP) norms. Renewal requires maintaining a minimum CGPA of 8.0 without backlogs and 80% attendance.
sourceDocument: Office of Dean Student Welfare - Scholarship Guidelines Rev 5

title: Campus Placements, Top Recruiters & Package Statistics
content: Placement Highlights for recent batch: Highest International Package: ₹44.5 LPA (Offered by global tech leader); Highest Domestic Package: ₹38.0 LPA; Average Package: ₹9.4 LPA (B.Tech AI & DS average: ₹11.2 LPA); Median Package: ₹8.2 LPA; Placement Percentage: 94.8% of eligible students placed. Key Recruiters: Google, Microsoft, Amazon, NVIDIA, AMD, Adobe, Cisco, Oracle, Infosys Springboard, TCS Digital, Cognizant GenC Next, Zomato, Razorpay. Placement season commences from 7th semester (July). Mock interviews, LeetCode competitive coding bootcamps, and resume clinics are held from the 5th semester onwards.

title: Hostel Accommodation, Facilities & Mess Charges
content: On-campus accommodation is available for 1,800+ boys and 1,200+ girls in separate multi-story hostels. Room Options & Annual Charges: Triple Occupancy (Non-AC): ₹65,000 / year; Double Occupancy (Air Conditioned): ₹92,000 / year; Single Occupancy (Final year merit students, AC): ₹1,15,000 / year. Mess Charges: ₹42,000 / year (Includes 4 meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Evening Snacks, Dinner). Vegetarian and special dietary menus available. Hostel Amenities: High-speed Wi-Fi 6 (1 Gbps backbone), 24/7 power backup, solar water heaters, gym, indoor badminton court, laundry service, study lounges, and round-the-clock biometric security with CCTV. Hostel curfew: 9:30 PM on weekdays, 10:30 PM on weekends.

title: Attendance Policy & Mandatory 75% Requirement
content: As per University Ordinance 4.1, a minimum of 75% physical attendance in every registered course (theory and practical separately) is mandatory to be eligible to appear in End-Semester Examinations. Attendance relaxations: Genuine Medical Grounds: Up to 10% relaxation (minimum 65% mandatory) upon submitting verified medical certificates from the Chief Medical Officer within 7 days of illness. Official Representation: Students representing the college in sports, hackathons, or cultural conferences are granted Duty Leave (DL) upon prior HOD approval. Students below 65% attendance will receive a 'De-barred' grade and must repeat the course during summer term.
sourceDocument: University Academic Ordinance Chapter IV Sec 12

title: Examination Scheme, Grading System & SGPA/CGPA Calculation
content: The institution follows a 10-Point Absolute Grading System: Mid-Semester Examination (Continuous Assessment): 40% weightage (Internal tests 20%, assignments/quizzes 10%, attendance/class participation 10%). End-Semester Examination: 60% weightage. Passing criteria: Minimum 40% aggregate in each subject and minimum 35% in End-Semester Exam. Grades: O (>=90%, 10 GP), A+ (80-89%, 9 GP), A (70-79%, 8 GP), B+ (60-69%, 7 GP), B (50-59%, 6 GP), C (40-49%, 5 GP), F (<40%, 0 GP). Backlog exams are held every semester.

title: Central Digital Library & Research Resources
content: The Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Central Digital Library is open 24x7 during examination months and from 8:00 AM to 11:00 PM on regular days. Key Resources: Over 85,000 print books and 15,000 reference monographs. Subscriptions to IEEE Xplore, ScienceDirect, ACM Digital Library, SpringerLink, and Nature. 100 dedicated multimedia workstations for literature search and coding. Remote access VPN provided to all students via college email ID. Free textbook sets issued to eligible students under Book Bank facility.

title: Supercomputing Lab & Advanced AI Hardware
content: The department houses the 'Turing-Hopper High Performance Computing (HPC) Center': 4x NVIDIA DGX A100 Workstations (320GB Tensor Core VRAM), 30x Alienware AI Workstations with RTX 4090 GPUs for undergraduate machine learning labs, high-speed InfiniBand 200Gbps fabric with 200TB NVMe storage cluster. Pre-installed with PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face Transformers, CUDA 12, JupyterHub, and Kubernetes. Every student receives an individual SSH key and JupyterHub account upon registering for AI courses.

title: Student Clubs, Hackathons & Annual Technical Fest (Cognitio)
content: Campus hosts 25+ student-led clubs across technical, cultural, and sports domains: Google Developer Student Club (GDSC), ACM Student Chapter, AI Research Society (AIRS) – Organizes weekly paper reading groups and Kaggle sprints, RoboTech Club (autonomous robotics and drone development), Rotaract & NSS. Flagship Events: Cognitio (Annual International Techno-Management Fest in October with ₹10 Lakhs in hackathon prizes), Spandan (Annual Cultural & Arts Fest in March), and Apex Premier League (APL inter-department sports).

title: Admission Document Verification Checklist
content: Mandatory documents required during physical reporting / document verification: 1. Class 10th (Secondary) Mark Sheet & Certificate (Proof of Date of Birth), 2. Class 12th (Higher Secondary) Mark Sheet & Passing Certificate, 3. Entrance Exam Score Card (JEE Main / State CET Rank Card), 4. Seat Allotment Letter issued by Counseling Authority, 5. Transfer Certificate (TC) & Character Certificate from previous institution, 6. Migration Certificate (Original), 7. Category / Caste Certificate (OBC-NCL / SC / ST / EWS) if applicable, 8. Medical Fitness Certificate signed by a registered MBBS Doctor, 9. 6 Passport-size color photos and Aadhaar Card copy.

title: Internship Policy & Industry Credit Transfer
content: All B.Tech students must complete a minimum of two internships before graduation: Mini Internship (4 weeks) post 4th semester (Summer break) focusing on industrial training or open-source contribution; Capstone Industry / Research Internship (6 months) in the 8th semester. Students securing semester-long internships at reputed product companies or research labs can convert full 8th-semester coursework into 12 industrial research credits upon weekly logbook submission and Viva-Voce defense.
